next_question.rationale: Reason clusters show many plans lapsed for time-related expiry ("due to treatment expiry": 827, "erx expired": 361, and 2,216 artifact expiries). The cuts we already ran show big conversion gaps by service_type (Haloskin 759 of 4,076, 18.62% vs Halofit 169 of 3,171, 5.33%) and by payer (free 684 of 3,868, 17.68% vs cash 235 of 3,370, 6.97%), which could be explained if creations concentrated in hours when doctor/prescription handoffs stall or expiry windows elapse. I expect to see substantially lower "paid for the plan" conversion in specific hours (late night or outside typical clinic hours); if so, that would point to time-bound operational fixes (staffing, expiry windows, or UI timing prompts) that could recover a large share of the 6,319 lost creations.
